name: timesfm
description: TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting.
one_liner: A ready-made AI model that looks at historical numbers (sales, demand, traffic) and predicts what happens next — no need to train your own forecasting model from scratch.
buyer: An e-commerce operations manager or FP&A analyst at a mid-size retailer who currently forecasts demand in a spreadsheet and needs better accuracy without hiring a data science team.
business_use_cases: A DTC brand forecasts SKU-level demand for the next 30 days to avoid overordering inventory before a big sale.
A subscription box company predicts churn-driven revenue dips a quarter ahead to plan cash flow.
A logistics company forecasts daily parcel volume per warehouse to schedule the right number of temp workers.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'forecasting as a service' subscription: customer connects their sales data, gets a weekly demand/revenue forecast dashboard.
Offer one-off forecasting audits for retailers who want a second opinion on their inventory planning before peak season.

steal_this: Build a single-page tool this weekend: upload a CSV of daily sales, get a 30-day forecast chart back — a Loom demo of that closes the first few customers.
